text:
sara_p: Quick triage on GA scope for private deployments. We need to pick exact profiles we promise at launch and a clear roadmap for expanding features after GA.

raj_backend: My proposal: 4 profiles but staged: A) Quickstart single-node (self-serve), B) VPC-managed (control plane hosted, inference local), C) Hybrid-control (hosted control plane + local model cache), D) Full-onprem airgap.

emily_se: +1 on staging. Customers often ask for Hybrid specifically. Suggest GA = A + B. Put C as early-access and D as "enterprise-engaged."

tom_ops: From an ops perspective we can support A/B with current infra. C requires changes to our routing and license checks. D needs a full offline packaging flow and extended SE support.

mike_product: Agreed. Let's write explicit launch gates per profile. For GA (A/B) gates: installer idempotency, documented ports & DNS entries, KMS for keys, opt-in hashed metrics, and an SE-deploy playbook.

sara_p: Can we be concrete about "documented ports & DNS entries"? customers want a single checklist.

raj_backend: Minimal outbound: TLS egress to api.region.redwood-inference.com on 443 for control-plane callbacks. For VPC-managed, control plane communicates via mTLS. No fixed IPs, provide region CNAMEs.

emily_se: Also need a graceful degrade mode when outbound is blocked: local queueing + pointer to offline bundle. That should be documented as "limited mode" behavior.

 tom_ops: Telemetry contract note: for GA let's require aggregated metrics only. Fields: requests_per_min, median_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct, model_digest, hashed_org. No user text or prompts. If customer opts out, we accept a periodic upload file.

mike_product: That's clearer than earlier drafts. Add audit logs and app-level request IDs for supportability.

raj_backend: Technical constraints: we cannot guarantee zero-downtime upgrades with model pinning unless we implement cache warmup and KV migration. Engineering estimate for rolling KV migration is 3 sprints.

emily_se: Customers pushing for zero-downtime will be segmented: small deployments (<4 GPUs) can do rolling, enterprises want SLA. We should communicate realistic SLOs: GA: best-effort rolling updates; enterprise SLA (post GA) for guaranteed <2min failover.

sara_p: Ok, include "upgrade behavior" in marketing copy: "best-effort rolling upgrades; enterprise-grade zero-downtime available via dedicated contract".

tom_ops: Runbook items: preflight network checklist, diag CLI, rollback window, health-check thresholds. I propose rollback window = 15 minutes for GA to be safe. We can shorten later.

mike_product: That conflicts with earlier suggestion of 10. Why 15?

tom_ops: For clusters with large model artifacts, image pull + cache warming can exceed 10min in real networks. 15 gives ops margin.

emily_se: Field team prefers 15 too. We'll include it in the SE checklist.

raj_backend: To help SEs, I'll add a small diag tool: rdpctl diag --network --tls --ports that prints: DNS resolution, TCP handshake to ports, cert chain, and sample curl to control plane. Example output snippet in docs.

support-bot: Note: created ticket #PD-472 for hybrid-control implementation. ETA = 2026-06-15 (tentative).

mike_product: Launch criteria checklist (GA):
- must: installer idempotency and preflight checks
- must: documented network/DNS/CNAMEs and simple diag tool
- must: KMS/HSM integration for keys
- must: aggregated telemetry (fields listed above) and opt-out path
- must: SE playbook + runbooks
- must: automated rollback within 15m window
- nice-to-have: KV-cache live migration, warm cache prefetch API, in-place model quantization tool

sara_p: Good. Prioritization: focus engineering on installer + diag tool + telemetry + KMS first sprint. KV migration in next two sprints.

emily_se: I'll draft two customer-facing docs: "Which private profile is right for you?" and a short "network checklist" for self-serve installs.

raj_backend: I'll prototype the diag tool and a telemetry emitter that writes local JSON when telemetry is disabled.

tom_ops: I'll own runbooks and the rollback play. Also will coordinate SE training.

mike_product: Timeline: PRD draft by Fri, engineering sprint plan by next Wed, public GA target = 2026-07-30 (tentative).

sara_p: Final call: messaging for air-gap (D) must be careful: label it "Advanced Ops — SE assisted" and do not promise GA availability.

emily_se: Noted. Will put that phrasing in the PRD.

sara_p: Thanks team. We reconvene Tue to review the PRD draft. :white_check_mark:
